messages:
Jordan Patel: Heads-up — BlueWave has spiked usage over the last 3 days, looks like they'll hit their soft quota by tomorrow morning. Planning proactive quota/limit outreach. Need owners for messaging + timeline. Priority: avoid surprise throttling. :eyes:
Priya Nair: I can draft the outreach template and timeline. Do we want email + in-app banner + portal notice? :memo:
Marco Ruiz: Email + in-app is good. Also recommend a short engineering note so we can temporary-config a small routing buffer (10%) to smooth spikes.
Owen Park: We can enable a temporary burst policy but need model name + region. Who has the exact usage numbers?
Jordan Patel: BlueWave is on redwood-prod-west, model rwd-7b-v1, last 24h peak 120k tokens/hour. If we bump quota for 48h it's ~$2.5k additional spend estimate.
Lena Cho: I'll own the customer-facing comms. Plan: 48h heads-up email, 6h reminder, day-of in-app banner. We should also offer a brief sync if they want to discuss capacity.
Samir Khan: Finance note: if we approve the bump, please tag charges to BLUEWAVE-OVERAGE so we can invoice/credit properly. Also include projected cost in the email.
Rita Gomez: Legal ok with standard overage wording we use. Please send me the draft before send.
Marco Ruiz: Draft snippet for email (feel free to tweak):
```
Subject: BlueWave — temporary capacity increase to prevent throttling
Hi Team BlueWave,
We noticed a rapid increase in usage and plan to enable a temporary capacity increase for 48 hours to prevent any interruptions. Estimated incremental cost: ~$2.5k. No action required on your side. If you'd prefer to discuss limits or set a permanent increase, reply here and we can schedule a quick call.
Thanks,
Lena / Redwood CS
```
Priya Nair: Timeline proposal: send initial email now (48h before), reminder 6h before, enable burst policy 30 min before peak window, day-of in-app banner. Add support contact + PSA about potential minor latency changes.
Jordan Patel: Also include rollback plan (automatic revert after 48h or on-demand revert if they want). And confirm support channel (support@redwood.ai or direct AE).
Lena Cho: I'll add a short FAQ link to onboarding docs and a line about how to request a permanent quota increase. Priya, can you include the billing line Samir mentioned?
Priya Nair: Yep — will add cost estimate + BLUEWAVE-OVERAGE tag. Draft coming in #cs-drafts by EOD.
Owen Park: I'm creating infra change request now: request-id REQ-2241, tag=bluewave-urgent, region=redwood-prod-west, model=rwd-7b-v1. Will post when change is scheduled.
alerts-bot: quota-change-request created: REQ-2241 (bluewave-urgent) — awaiting approval.
Rita Gomez: Received, will review the draft wording once posted.
Samir Khan: Noted for billing. If they want to convert to reserved capacity later, let's get an ROI calc after the bump.
Jordan Patel: OK team — action items: Lena owns comms, Priya drafts + posts in #cs-drafts, Owen files infra change (REQ-2241), Marco will monitor routing buffer, Samir tags billing, Rita reviews wording. 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00am to confirm send. :thumbsup:
Lena Cho: Confirmed 10:00am. I'll send calendar invite.
Priya Nair: I'll post draft by 5pm PST today.
Marco Ruiz: I'll stand by for logs/metrics to watch once burst enabled.
Owen Park: Change scheduled for 2026-03-21 09:30 UTC, will update if anything shifts.
Jordan Patel: Thanks everyone — want to avoid any surprises for BlueWave. 
Priya Nair: final note — I'll include an opt-out line in the email in case they do not want the bump. :white_check_mark:
